title: plugin-approvals: authorization-adjacent disclosure on the approval request doors (detail withheld pending maintainer)
body:
QA-source: #25479 · approvals.record-page-decisions · observed beside the clauses
QA-source: #25478 · approvals.account-app-entry · observed beside the clauses

An authorization-adjacent behavior on the plugin-approvals HTTP doors was observed independently by two runners on `main` 77392e90 (stock showcase, non-participant member persona). It is an information-disclosure class finding. The runners rated it low severity: no field value is disclosed, and the identifiers involved are random.

**Detail withheld pending maintainer.** Under the RUNNER rule 2 carve-out, the reproduction is not published. It is held in the runner session and is available to the maintainer on request.
